data.long_meaning: A beautiful Islamic name with deep spiritual significance. The name Abdul carries the meaning “Noble and blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abdul usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the Blessing and Faith and Nobility nature of Allah.
data.etymology: Abdul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abdul total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
